lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you're digging in your yard and find a treasure chest, you're rich. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the gold shines so bright, the whole street can see it. So you dig a deeper hole to hide it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the chest is way too heavy to lift. So you build a pulley that lowers it for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the neighbor has a metal detector. So you bury it deeper than the detector can reach.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the dog keeps sniffing the spot. So you throw a bone to the other side of the yard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, your treasure is perfectly hidden.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Thanks for finding my savings, kiddo.
